sin.name: short-circuit-statement
sin.description: A bare `a && b()` or `a || b()` statement: a short-circuit whose value nothing reads, so the operator is an `if` in disguise
sin.rule: Branch with an `if`; never run work off the right side of a bare `&&`/`||` (`and`/`or`) whose value nothing reads.
sin.suggestion: Write the condition as an `if` and the right side as its body, negating it for an `||`.
